# whisper (turu)

> charly-vibes knowledge-routing CLI: canonical repo keys, branch slugs, and
> scope-based knowledge storage/recall for AI agents — deterministic, JSON
> envelope throughout, built on genesis-vibes conventions.

## Install

```bash
cargo install whisper-vibes
```

## Commands

`key`, `resolve`, `append`, `recall`, `distill`, `bundle`, `init`, `status`,
`check`, `consolidate`, `doctor`, `sync`, `feedback`, `skill install`.
Full reference: https://charly-vibes.github.io/whisper/ (docs/src/cli.md)

## Why

Agents accumulate operational knowledge across sessions, but "where does this
note go?" is a question models answer unreliably. turu turns that mechanical
routing layer into a deterministic binary.

## Status

Beta — core works, used in anger by other ecosystem tools; surface may shift
before 1.0. See docs/src/status.md.
